static_traits.name: 孟瑶
static_traits.social_status: 有一位可倾诉工作问题的朋友，但尚not yet分享自己Self-doubt与without能感的程度
static_traits.medical_history: not yet出现类似问题史；not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，能具体描述感受与自动化思维，配合度较好；语速Not mentioned

basic_info.main_problem: 每当顾客not喜欢他们的饮品时，我就觉得自己是最差的员工，进而产生without能感与自我责备。这种感受在过去一年工作中一直存在，近期因负面反馈增多而加重，导致我not断怀疑自己的能力并害怕在工作中犯错。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些without能感开始影响我的自信和工作表现；我希望能更好地处理负面反馈，not再让它过度影响我。

special_situations.event: 顾客对饮品表示not满或退回饮品
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果顾客not满意，就说明我能力not足、是个失败者
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly replays mistakes, over-examines self, and practices doubly hard to avoid erring again

special_situations.event: Receiving negative feedback about taste or temperature
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 任何负面反馈都证明我做得一without是处
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Strives to seek more positive feedback to prove oneself, but is still dominated by negative evaluations

special_situations.event: 在工作中犯错或被顾客批评
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦犯错，我就会被视为not称职，而且我永远not会进步
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Becomes tense and cautious when interacting with customers to avoid making mistakes again

special_situations.event: 与not满意的顾客互动并听到负面评论
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他们一定认为我很糟糕，问题都在我身上
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoidant and cautious when communicating with customers, trying to reduce the risk of being criticized

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被认可为称职、获得积极评价与接纳
core_conflict.fear: 害怕被批评和negate，害怕犯错后被视为not称职
defense_goal: 通过自我批评与完美追求来降低被negate的风险
Maintains caution and a degree of avoidance in interactions with customers to stay safe

object_relations.object_representation: 挑剔的评判者（not满意的顾客）

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 在会谈中多次将负面反馈完全归因于自己（如“It is all my fault”）
谈及与顾客互动时表现出过度紧张与回避

positive_force: Willing to seek help and cooperate with counseling (actively participates in reality testing)
曾获得顾客的正面反馈与回头客
主动尝试提升skill与改进工作表现
negative_force: 过度Self-denial与标签化（“I am the worst employee”）
心理过滤与过度概括，忽视正面反馈
害怕犯错与被批评，导致紧张与回避沟通
对他人评价高度敏感，倾向读心与个人化

target_behavior.behavior: 在顾客not满时出现强烈自责与Anxiety，并回避与顾客沟通
antecedent: 顾客对饮品表示not满或退回饮品
Receiving negative feedback about taste or temperature
target_behavior.core_reason: 将负面反馈个人化并以全或without标准评价自我，形成“I cannot do anything well/I am the worst employee”等自动化思维
target_behavior.function: Avoids negative evaluation and potential criticism, tries to lower the risk of mistakes
target_behavior.consequence: Decline in work performance，Damaged confidence，与顾客互动紧张，Anxiety intensified
